 subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-ss',str(second),'-i',s['jobs'][index]['outputPath'],'-frames:v','1','-vf','scale=640:360','-y','analysis/render-queue-2026-10-28/'+name+'.png'],check=True)
